S4.scope: 2022 methodological review of locus of interference

claims.claim: Stroop published the study in 1935
claims.public_copy_rule: A 1935 study examined color-word interference.

claims.claim: Original journal volume 18 number 6 pages 643–662
claims.public_copy_rule: Source trail bibliographic citation.

claims.claim: Two properties can conflict: printed word and ink hue
claims.public_copy_rule: Color-name words can carry conflicting task cues.

claims.claim: Original comparison was timing reading 100 conflicting words
claims.public_copy_rule: Do not call it one universal individual test.

claims.claim: Word-reading comparison 2.3 seconds slower
claims.public_copy_rule: Only for original reported comparison.

claims.claim: Word-reading comparison 5.6 percent increase
claims.public_copy_rule: Only for original reported comparison.

claims.claim: Word-reading increase was not reliable
claims.public_copy_rule: Cannot claim a universal word-reading deficit.

claims.claim: Ink naming incongruent words increased 47 seconds for 100 items
claims.public_copy_rule: Relative to particular original controls.

claims.claim: Ink naming was 74.3 percent slower in original comparison
claims.public_copy_rule: Do not generalize as per-person score.

claims.claim: Experiment recruited several hundred college students
claims.public_copy_rule: Different phases may have different sample sizes.

claims.claim: Stroop assessed learning and persistence of conflict effects
claims.public_copy_rule: Described as tested, not a universal training effect.

claims.claim: MacLeod published an integrative review in 1991
claims.public_copy_rule: Review historical literature, not proprietary audio.

claims.claim: 2022 review highlights unresolved processing locus
claims.public_copy_rule: Reject single-cause certainty.

claims.claim: Color-word interference exists in multiple research paradigms
claims.public_copy_rule: Effects depend on protocol and comparison conditions.

claims.claim: Our visual card is a validated laboratory assessment
claims.public_copy_rule: Explicitly label as illustrative only.

claims.claim: Home Stroop scores diagnose ADHD or cognitive disorders
claims.public_copy_rule: No diagnosis, no score, no inference.

claims.claim: Color-vision differences and language can alter reader task access
claims.public_copy_rule: Provide an equivalent conceptual explanation.

claims.claim: 2021 group mindfulness review included 29 studies
claims.public_copy_rule: Adult systematic review, not Zen12 evaluation.

claims.claim: 2021 review found effects across all executive domains robust
claims.public_copy_rule: Review reports inconsistent findings and nonrobust overall effect.

claims.claim: 2024 meta-analysis pooled 111 randomized trials
claims.public_copy_rule: For meditation-naive participants, multiple intervention models.

claims.claim: 2024 meta-analysis participants numbered 9538
claims.public_copy_rule: Sample from review, not Zen12 users.

claims.claim: 2024 synthesis found small-to-moderate effects on some accuracy outcomes
claims.public_copy_rule: Not all cognition domains improved.

claims.claim: 2024 synthesis found general response-speed improvement
claims.public_copy_rule: No effect on executive-function latency indices or processing speed.

claims.claim: Mindfulness evidence proves Zen12 improves Stroop reaction time
claims.public_copy_rule: No product-specific transfer established.

claims.claim: NCCIH considers meditation evidence and possible adverse experiences
claims.public_copy_rule: Nonclinical practice must permit stopping; no guarantee.

claims.claim: Zen12 merchant describes 12 levels
claims.public_copy_rule: Seller describes the program as twelve levels.

claims.claim: Zen12 merchant describes 12-minute sessions
claims.public_copy_rule: Seller describes each session as twelve minutes.

claims.claim: Zen12 merchant describes four listening styles per level
claims.public_copy_rule: A choice of audio format, not efficacy proof.

claims.claim: Zen12 current checkout lists 48 MP3 files
claims.public_copy_rule: Recheck before publication; omit current price.

claims.claim: Zen12 current checkout describes guides and support
claims.public_copy_rule: Claims about inclusions, not results.

claims.claim: 12 Zen12 minutes are equivalent to one hour meditation
claims.public_copy_rule: Never repeat as a demonstrated fact.

claims.claim: Proprietary brainwave sounds automatically cause deeper meditation
claims.public_copy_rule: Do not imply independent efficacy demonstrated.

claims.claim: Zen12 clinically treats attention disorders
claims.public_copy_rule: Do not make health or diagnosis claims.

claims.claim: Zen12 will guarantee better focus and productivity
claims.public_copy_rule: No guaranteed cognitive outcome.

claims.claim: Zen12 advertises a return policy / guarantee
claims.public_copy_rule: Do not quote time/terms without same-day check.

claims.claim: Zen12 says not to listen while driving or operating machinery
claims.public_copy_rule: Include in precise product guide.

claims.claim: Zen12 free audio promotion entails seller newsletter
claims.public_copy_rule: Never conflate with existing Jetpack.

claims.claim: Final Vestige has approved Inspire3 affiliate agreement
claims.public_copy_rule: Withhold affiliate activation pending authenticated agreement.

claims.claim: Final Vestige possesses approved tracked link for Zen12
claims.public_copy_rule: No merchant checkout CTA in public HTML.

claims.claim: Approved swipe creative and usage rights have been verified
claims.public_copy_rule: Never reproduce merchant images/claims.

claims.claim: Publisher has tested or used Zen12
claims.public_copy_rule: No personal testimonial.

claims.claim: Material commission connection needs clear near-link disclosure
claims.public_copy_rule: Use plain words about commission in same CTA block.

claims.claim: Affiliate link label alone is adequate disclosure
claims.public_copy_rule: Explicit commission disclosure instead.

claims.claim: Objective health claims need adequate substantiation
claims.public_copy_rule: Product-specific scientific support required.

claims.claim: Seller testimonials validate advertised expected results
claims.public_copy_rule: No adoption of third-party endorsements.

claims.claim: Existing Focus page is published, page ID 1579
claims.public_copy_rule: Link directly, do not duplicate subscriber form.

claims.claim: Puységur archive is published, page ID 1377
claims.public_copy_rule: History bridge, not a product test.

claims.claim: Privacy-safe experiment can infer sales from outbound clicks
claims.public_copy_rule: Outbound is not purchase; vendor reporting separate.

claims.claim: A Stroop task proves self-hypnosis can reprogram the brain
claims.public_copy_rule: No claim transferring unrelated evidence.

claims.claim: Merchant price/commission can be quoted confidently without account checkout
claims.public_copy_rule: Explicitly exclude rates, payout and prices.

claims.claim: Activation of seller link may precede partner approval
claims.public_copy_rule: Fail closed until written approval and checked link.
